svg.title: Where 100,000 sats go in a real Spark exit
svg.desc: Blink's mainnet exit at 1 sat per vbyte: 89,668 sats arrived at the destination, 9,888 sats were left behind in Spark as 18 dust leaves not worth exiting, and 444 sats went to sweep fees. Separately, 8,388 sats of exit fees were paid from a different on-chain coin.
svg.text: Where 100,000 sats go in a real Spark exit
Blink's mainnet test at 1 sat/vB: 22 leaves, only 4 worth exiting.
18 dust leaves that cost more to exit than they hold
Not in the bar: 8,388 sats of exit fees, paid from a separate on-chain coin you must already own.
Source: Blink, "Case study: a real Spark unilateral exit on Bitcoin mainnet" (2026-07-13). Exiting all 22 leaves would have cost about 79% in fees.
